ad: People gather on a snowy path, encircled by trees. They anticipate the arrival of a dog sled race. This setting is a wooded region featuring a distinct, snow-covered route. Some individuals stand on a small incline next to the path, while others occupy the route itself, all warmly attired against the chilly conditions. An air of expectation fills the scene as they gaze down the path, awaiting the racers' emergence.
